summary: Aon North America, Inc. and Aon Global Holdings plc priced a $13.5 billion senior notes offering across seven tranches (5.350% 2029s through 6.450% 2056s), guaranteed by Aon plc, Aon Corporation, and Aon Global Limited. Proceeds are earmarked for the previously announced USI Acquisition; $11.5 billion are designated USI Acquisition Notes, with $2.0 billion of 6.450% 2056s fungible general-purpose. No board recommendation or advisor named in the excerpt. Watch for USI deal closing and post-issuance leverage trajectory.
